official_source_url.value: https://mfa.gov.sc/visa/ — Seychelles Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Diaspora visa page lists a "Recent passport size photo" among the required visa application documents, but does not specify exact dimensions, background colour, or format. Note: most travellers to Seychelles instead use the Travel Authorisation (TA) via the Seychelles Electronic Border System (seychelles.govtas.com), whose own published pages (HOWTO, FAQ) also do not list a specific photo size/background spec.
